newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota, Daihatsu, Hino recall 168,853 Japan vehicles.
newsitem.headline: Toyota, Daihatsu, Hino recall 168,853 Japan vehicles.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp, Daihatsu Motor Co Ltd and Hino Motors Ltd said separately on Tuesday they were recalling a total of 168,853 four-wheel-drive vehicles and light trucks in Japan in order to repair brake components.
The total cost of repair for Toyota is estimated at about three billion yen in Japan, a Toyota spokesman said.

Toyota vehicles accounted for 163,761 out of the total number being recalled. This figure comprises 11 Toyota models including the Land Cruiser, Dayna truck, and ToyoAce. Four Daihatsu models totalling 3,192 vehicles, and four Hino models totalling 1,900 vehicles were also being recalled.
They were made between December 1, 1989 and June 28, 1994 using Nippondenso Co Ltd rotors and blades.
The brake system will cause a decline in braking force due to the faulty blades. No accidents have been reported.

Toyota will also repair the same fault in a total of about 212,000 vehicles exported to 178 countries including Australia, Britain, and Saudi Arabia, in accordance with the rules of each country, the Toyota spokesman said.
